sections.title: Sound of X
paragraphs: The letter (X) /ks/ is called ex. You hear its main sound in (box) /bɒks/, a square container. This letter makes three different sounds in English.

sections.title: How to say X
paragraphs: For the first sound, stop the air with the back of your tongue. Then push air through your front teeth without voice. For the second sound, turn your voice on for both parts. Feel your throat shake. For the third sound, push voiced air through your front teeth. A voiced sound makes your throat shake.

sections.title: Spelling of X
paragraphs: This letter usually sounds like the ending of (fox) /fɒks/. You hear it before a stressed vowel in (exam) /ɪɡ.zæm/. At the beginning of a word, it sounds like the start of (xylophone) /zaɪ.lə.fəʊn/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with X
paragraphs: Do not say two sounds at the start of a word. When this letter begins a word, say only one voiced hissing sound. Touch your throat to feel it shake.
